name: unbound
description: Unbound: FastAPI backend + React frontend. Scripts wrap docker compose and the frontend package.

scripts.dev: docker compose up -d --build backend worker && npm run dev --prefix frontend
scripts.test: docker compose exec -w /app backend python -m pytest -q tests/
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run build && npm test
scripts.guidelines:import: docker compose exec -w /app backend python -m app.cli.import_guidelines data/guidelines/
scripts.models:list: docker compose exec backend python -m app.cli.list_models
